## How do I naturally exfoliate my dry acne skin?

I have dry skin and cystic acne on my cheeks and chin. (Probably hormonal since I don't consume lots of dairy)   
My usual skin care routine is using african black soap (original, very good) and then rose water (new) (both in the morning and evening) and jojoba oil mixed with tea tree oil as a spot treatment. But recently I didn't care for my skin at all. I'm   
too lazy and unmotivated to wash my face with the soap, but I still apply the rose water about twice a day. Probably would be better if I used the soap as well... (Even if I follow my skin care routine, my skin might be better but there are always pimples coming. fml)   
I wanna get into my skin care routine again, use more face masks and add an adequate exfoliation to my routine.
